name: Empty state
import: import { EmptyState, EmptyStateIcon, EmptyStateTitle, EmptyStateDescription, EmptyStateActions } from "@/components/ui/empty-state"
description: A calm fallback block for empty collections, filtered results, and first-run setup.

EmptyState.description: Root layout wrapper. Owns spacing, alignment, and the soft surface.

children.description: Use EmptyStateIcon, EmptyStateTitle, EmptyStateDescription, optional custom content, and EmptyStateActions.

variant.description: Surface treatment. Default is soft-fill; quiet removes the fill; tinted uses the secondary surface.

size.description: Vertical density. Use sm inside panels and lg for full-page or first-run states.

align.description: Content alignment. Use start when the empty state sits inside a left-aligned settings or table area.

render.description: Polymorphic render target, Base UI style. Rarely needed.

className.description: Layout escape hatch only; do not restyle surface, tone, radius, or spacing.

EmptyStateIcon.description: Decorative visual anchor. Usually wraps a lucide icon.

children.description: A decorative icon with aria-hidden, or omit the part when an icon would add noise.

render.description: Use only when the icon wrapper needs different semantics.

className.description: Layout escape hatch only; do not recolor ad hoc.

EmptyStateTitle.description: Short heading that explains what is empty.

children.description: One short sentence fragment, not a promo headline.

render.description: Use to render the correct heading level for the surrounding page.

EmptyStateDescription.description: Supporting copy that explains the next useful step.

children.description: One concise sentence or two short lines. Avoid required information that only appears here.

render.description: Use only when a different semantic element is needed.

EmptyStateActions.description: Optional action row. Compose real Button components here.

children.description: One primary Button and, rarely, one secondary Button. Actions stack on mobile.

render.description: Use only when a different semantic wrapper is needed.

forbidden: Do not use EmptyState as a decorative card when content exists.
Do not put domain-specific copy in generic examples.
Do not invent custom icon colors or borders via className.
Do not hide important recovery guidance only in an icon or tooltip.
Do not put more than two primary-looking actions in EmptyStateActions.

responsive.note: EmptyState itself is static. Buttons inside EmptyStateActions must keep kubkit Button sizing so mobile tap targets stay at least 44px.

example:
<EmptyState>
  <EmptyStateIcon><Inbox aria-hidden /></EmptyStateIcon>
  <EmptyStateTitle>No messages yet</EmptyStateTitle>
  <EmptyStateDescription>New conversations will appear here.</EmptyStateDescription>
  <EmptyStateActions>
    <Button>Create message</Button>
  </EmptyStateActions>
</EmptyState>
